newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent testing downside, NYMEX on support.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent testing downside, NYMEX on support.

text.p: May Brent crude futures were lower in late afternoon dealings on Tuesday as players tested the downside potential.
May last traded at $19.55 per barrel, down four cents from London's overnight settlement at $19.59 and below the London intraday low of $19.58.
Brokers said they expected another technical move on the downside in the short term after the last attempt found support on the front month at $18.68.
However, the downtrend could be interrupted Tuesday by short covering ahead of the release of API stock data in the United States, a broker said.
NYMEX May crude was testing support at $21.00 after New York trading overnight failed to breach $21.02.
However, ACCESS trading punctured the support and pushed prices down to $20.98 before recovering to hover just above the support number.
In late afternoon trading in Asia, May NYMEX was last traded at $21.02, down four cents from New York's close.
